question: After resolving the current-main conflicts, does the merged result preserve the intended Plugin SDK contract and WhatsApp media-delivery behavior without restoring the unrestricted reader fallback?
rationale: The reviewed head is internally consistent, but only a maintainer reviewing the three-way resolution can confirm which current-main exports and owner-boundary changes are intentional contracts.

options.title: Rebase and preserve both boundaries
options.body: Resolve the conflicts by retaining current-main SDK contracts while keeping explicit local roots, shared MIME classification, strict base64 parsing, and canonical audio transcoding.

options.title: Pause the media consolidation
options.body: Keep the PR open without landing if current-main changes reveal that the proposed SDK or WhatsApp ownership boundary is no longer the intended direction.

recommendation.title: Rebase and preserve both boundaries
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts by retaining current-main SDK contracts while keeping explicit local roots, shared MIME classification, strict base64 parsing, and canonical audio transcoding.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent WhatsApp feature history and can distinguish transport-specific behavior from shared-media ownership during conflict resolution.
